title: RC circuit step response
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for a first-order RC circuit with resistance_ohm, capacitance_f, source_v, initial_v, and times_s. Return {"voltages_v":[V(t),...]} in supplied time order, using V(t)=source_v+(initial_v-source_v)*exp(-t/(R*C)). R and C must be strictly positive: otherwise return {"error":"invalid_circuit"}. After checking the circuit, reject any negative time with {"error":"negative_time"}. Empty times are valid. All numbers are finite; products and exponents in valid tests are representable. Time is seconds and capacitance is farads, not microfarads. Do not mutate input. Absolute and relative tolerance 1e-8.
